texts.title: What is Ayurveda? — The Science of Life
texts.body:
Ayurveda is one of the world's oldest holistic healing systems, developed more than 5,000 years ago in India. It is based on the belief that health and wellness depend on a delicate balance between the mind, body, and spirit.

The primary focus of Ayurveda is to promote good health rather than fight disease. At Shuddhi HiiMS, we combine this ancient wisdom with modern diagnostic techniques.

texts.title: Benefits of Panchakarma Detox
texts.body:
Panchakarma is a Sanskrit word meaning "five actions" or "five treatments." It is a process used to clean the body of toxic materials left by disease, poor nutrition, and environmental toxins.

Our experts at Shuddhi HiiMS customize each Panchakarma program based on individual health needs.

texts.title: 5 Ayurvedic Herbs You Should Know
texts.body:
1. Ashwagandha — Known as Indian Ginseng, it helps reduce stress and anxiety while boosting immunity.

2. Turmeric (Haldi) — A powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant.

3. Tulsi (Holy Basil) — Excellent for respiratory health and stress relief.

4. Triphala — Aids digestion and detoxification.

5. Brahmi — Improves memory, concentration, and cognitive function.
